title: Bluetooth issue (serious?)
symptom: Bluetooth connection breaks down after minutes to hours, causing hundreds of missed readings, and does not recover without deleting the Dexcom transmitter from the Bluetooth device list and restarting the phone. This started after switching to a Firefly transmitter.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. Possible factors discussed include the Firefly transmitter behaving differently, OB1 authentication issues, and settings related to OB1 bonding.
fix: One user (Davud2020) reported that setting specific options resolved the issue: Settings-->G5/G6 Debug Settings: Use the OB1 Collector, Native Algorithm, Minimize Scanning, Avoid Scanning, G6 Support, Allow OB1 initiate bonding; and Less common settings-->Bluetooth Settings: Turn Bluetooth on, Bluetooth Watchdog, Trust Auto-Connect. However, the original reporter oblanke changed settings to match but did not confirm resolution before the issue was closed due to inactivity.
evidence_quote: I had to setup. Settings-->G5/G6 Debug Settings Use the OB1 Collector Native Algorithm Minimize Scanning Avoid Scanning G6 Support Allow OB1 initiate bonding Less common settings-->Bluetooth Settings Turn Bluetooth on Bluetooth Watchdog Trust Auto-Connect
